title: Dispute Resolution
outcomes: Explain the constitution and purpose of the DRC.
Test whether an order and a person qualify.
Apply the DRC application procedure and timelines.
Explain DRC orders and their finality.

meta.exam_tip: Check the ₹10 lakh and ₹50 lakh limits and the search/survey exclusion before anything else.

concepts.title: Constitution and purpose of the DRC
body: Section 379 provides Dispute Resolution Committees (DRCs) to resolve disputes of small and medium taxpayers quickly and reduce litigation. The CBDT constitutes DRCs under rules, and the e-Dispute Resolution Scheme, 2022 makes the process faceless.

Each DRC has three members: two retired Indian Revenue Service officers and one serving officer of the rank of Principal Commissioner or Commissioner, for the PCCIT region. Retired members serve fixed terms; decisions are by majority.
The DRC can reduce or waive penalty and grant immunity from prosecution for offences under the Act, subject to conditions under Rule 198.
concepts.analogy: A small panel replaces a long appeal for modest disputes.
concepts.work: A shop owner with a ₹6 lakh addition can seek DRC resolution instead of a first appeal.

concepts.title: Specified order and specified person
body: Specified order (section 379(4)): a draft order, intimation, assessment or reassessment order, rectification order or TDS default order where the aggregate variation does not exceed ₹10 lakh, the returned income (if a return was filed) does not exceed ₹50 lakh, and the order is not based on a search, requisition, survey or treaty information exchange.

Specified person: one not subject to detention under COFEPOSA, not prosecuted under laws such as the IPC/BNS for tax-related offences, UAPA, NDPS, the Benami Act, the Black Money Act or PMLA, and not convicted in income-tax prosecutions.
Both conditions — specified order and specified person — must be satisfied for an application to be valid.
concepts.analogy: Small variation, modest income, no search or survey, clean record.
concepts.work: An addition based on survey findings cannot go to the DRC.

concepts.title: Procedure before the DRC
body: The application is filed electronically with a fee of ₹1,000 and proof of tax paid on returned income, within one month of receipt of the specified order (or within the time specified by the Board where an appeal is already pending before the CIT(A)).

The DRC may reject an ineligible application after a show-cause notice; the time taken for admission is excluded in computing the time to appeal. If admitted, the assessee must furnish proof of withdrawal of any appeal or DRP objection within 30 days.
The DRC may call for records, seek reports and hear the assessee; communications are electronic and the assessee responds within specified times.
concepts.analogy: Apply within a month, pay ₹1,000, withdraw other proceedings once admitted.
concepts.work: An application against an order received on 20 January 2027 is due by 20 February 2027.

concepts.title: Orders of the DRC and their effect
body: The DRC must pass its order within six months after the close of the month in which the application is admitted. It may modify the variations, decline to modify, and in either case reduce or waive penalty and grant immunity from prosecution, or simply dispose of the application.
The AO gives effect to the DRC order by passing a modified order within one month after the close of the month in which it is received, with a notice of demand.
No appeal or revision lies against the modified order, and an eligible assessee cannot then go to the DRP or first appellate authority against it.
concepts.analogy: The DRC's outcome is final for that order.
concepts.work: Once a modified order is passed, the matter cannot be taken to the CIT(A).

summary: Specified order: variation ≤ ₹10 lakh, returned income ≤ ₹50 lakh, no search/survey.
Order within six months; AO gives effect in one month.
remember: DRC can waive penalty and grant immunity.
traps: Assuming appeal is still available after DRC.

viva.q: What relief can the DRC grant besides modifying variations?
viva.model: It can reduce or waive penalty and grant immunity from prosecution under Rule 198.

viva.q: Who is a specified person for DRC?
viva.model: A person free from specified detention orders, prosecutions under listed laws and income-tax convictions.

viva.q: What happens if an application is found ineligible?
viva.model: It is rejected after a show-cause notice, and the time taken is excluded for filing an appeal.

viva.q: Within what time does the AO give effect to a DRC order?
viva.model: Within one month after the close of the month in which the order is received.

viva.q: Can an eligible assessee approach the DRP after a DRC-modified draft order?
viva.model: The DRP route closes; the modified order stands and only payment of the demand follows.
